lines.zh: 我一节一节地拱着往前。
lines.en: I work forward segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我从洞口的土里钻出来。
lines.en: I push out of the mouth of my burrow.
I bore a tunnel through the soil.
I crawl slowly along the ground.
I stretch and bunch and cross half a foot.
I squeeze through a patch of loose earth.
I crawl along a tree root.
I head into the darker soil.
I turn a slow bend.
I pass under a gap in the stones.
I raise a mound and burrow in.
I drag my body forward.
I hesitate once and push on.
I bore deeper.
I crawl along the damp earth.
I squeeze out between grass roots.
I lie half out of the soil, still.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身子缩回去一点。
lines.en: I draw my body back a little.
I wait at the burrow mouth a while.
Something tiny moves in the soil.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有环节在颤。
lines.en: I hold still and only my segments quiver.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，朝着黑处。
lines.en: I lift my head toward the dark.
My body is wet.
I retreat an inch into the soil.
I listen to the steps above.
I arch my front half up.
I slowly take a new heading.
I make no stir whatsoever.

lines.zh: 我把前半身拱起来对着你。
lines.en: I arch my front half toward you.
You are standing on my soil.
I show my head at the burrow mouth.
I hold still and watch you.
You stamp once and I pull back.
I hold at the burrow edge.
You do not bend down, so I do not move.
Half my body is in the soil.
I work a little further forward.
I draw back in again.
I coil back into the soil.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的环节打断了。
lines.en: That broke my segments.
I bore desperately deeper.
The soil is churned up.
Part of me still shows above the soil.
I move a bit at a time.

lines.zh: 我分泌出黏液护住伤口。
lines.en: I coat the wound with slime.
I can still burrow.
I keep that in a segment.
I draw in a little more.
The soil smells of rotting leaves.
I burrow that way.
I push a layer of leaves aside.
I swallow it slowly.
This piece is too dry.
I burrow back into the soil.
I circle it half way round.
I drag it down into the burrow.
I swallow little by little.
I leave it in the soil.
The step makes me pull in.
I withdraw entirely into the burrow.
I slowly poke back out.
The soil caves and buries me.
One push and I work free.
I bore sideways.
I hold where I am.
Wait until it is quiet above.
Half my body is still outside.
I bore deeper.
We come together in the soil.
It bores over beside me.
We press our bodies together.
I arch half a circle around it.
When it moves, the soil loosens.
We bore apart again.
I wait for it at the burrow mouth.
It burrowed away deep.
We make not the least sound.
The soil closes over again.
I push a rotten leaf into my mouth.
I swallow a mouthful of soil.
Too hard for me to gnaw.
I drag it to the burrow mouth.
I swallow it slowly.
It sticks in my mouth.
I spat it out.
I stuff it beneath my body.
I burrow back to look.
I found nothing.
There is a tremor above.
My head turns that way.
I have made out that side.
I draw my body taut.
I bore toward it.
The soil has been packed down.
I stop in the soil and listen.
It is very near the burrow mouth.
I draw my body taut.
A little further forward.
Something moves outside the burrow.

lines.zh: 我把前半身收起，准备退。
lines.en: I gather my front half, ready to retreat.
I follow it under the soil.
It moves and I halt.
I press to the burrow wall.
I wait for it to withdraw.
Sounds come muffled through the soil.
I probe out of another opening.
I shrink back where I was.
I bore a different way.
When it is quiet I will move.
I ease along the burrow wall.
I head for another opening.
I arch up and butt it.
I bite at its foot.
I coil round it once.
That had very little force.
I pull back quickly.
I bite down once more.
It stamps and the soil caves.
I retreat into the burrow.
I am covered in mud.
I am not coming out.
I push up out of the mud.
This is the Wormy cave of Kavarin.
The soil is loose and easy to bore.
I poke half my body out first.
Water drips from the cave wall.
I turn my head toward the dark.
I raise a mound of soil.

lines.zh: 这一带一点声音都没有。
lines.en: There is not a sound here.
I bore a little deeper.
I ease back into the burrow.

lines.zh: 土被烤干，我只能往深处钻。
lines.en: The soil dries in the heat and I dive deeper.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，重重砸在地上。
lines.en: I fall and hit the ground hard.
Water floods the burrow and I thrash.

lines.zh: 炸响把土掀开，我被抛出来。
lines.en: The blast throws the soil open and me with it.
Something drove into my body.

lines.zh: 冷意钻进土里，我僵住了。
lines.en: Cold seeps into the soil and I stiffen.

lines.zh: 土里没吃的，我越来越细。
lines.en: No food in the soil and I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷顺着湿土下来，我整条一颤。
lines.en: Lightning comes down through the wet soil and I spasm.
The soil is gone and I fall away.
